title: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and sword-wielding protector who, in a dreamlike vision, is shown the invasions and chooses to protect Wrenn's mission at the Invasion Tree, being reborn with wings.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The creator of Serra's Realm whose spirit guides Elspeth, first appearing in the likeness of Elspeth's mother and later revealed as Serra; she remakes Elspeth into what she was meant to be.

entities.name: Elspeth's mother
entities.description: The dead woman in Elspeth's childhood memory, whose face the guiding voice borrows.

entities.name: Young Elspeth
entities.description: The child version of Elspeth in the dungeon memory, who speaks with a voice without youth and is revealed to be Elspeth herself.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A friend of Elspeth on Theros whose warm voice guides her through the vision of Theros, now holding a new station.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Elspeth's old mentor, now Phyrexian-converted and trying to convert Theros's gods and priests.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros whose temple is being corrupted; a severed head of his statue lies in the wreckage.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A former angel corrupted by four praetors, one of Phyrexia's most fanatical generals, who massacres New Capenna with a scythe.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who sits on a porcelain throne at the Invasion Tree and celebrates her victory over the Mirrans.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor with tubes at his maw, whose army packs the bridge before the Invasion Tree and who is called to harvest the prisoners.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor tortured and dismembered on a machine before Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A ravaged planeswalker brought before Norn, whose eyes still show signs of life.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A beaten rebel leader of the Mirran resistance who is brought before Norn.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker torn from her tree and brought before Norn, whom Elspeth chooses to help reach the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker, bloody and unable to kneel, brought as a prisoner before Norn.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated Phyrexian version of Nissa who serves as a centurion of Norn and presents the rebel prisoners.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose time magic Elspeth briefly suspects when time stops.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading forces seen across the Multiverse, including splicers, centurions and winged beasts.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian realm whose invasion sets all the planes aflame.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: A tree-like Phyrexian monument on Mirrodin that pierces the heavens, testament to Elesh Norn's triumphs.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A fortified city plane whose Park Heights is attacked by Phyrexians under Atraxa.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper levels of New Capenna where Riveteers fight Phyrexian winged beasts.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Ajani is converting gods and where Elspeth once found a new light.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city of Theros, now burning and ruined.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A New Capennan group holding out with hot tools against the invaders.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Shackled mortal survivors and rebels of Mirrodin whose capture Norn celebrates.

entities.name: Sigiled knights
entities.description: Knights glimpsed in Elspeth's vision of Eldraine defending against Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane where the Invasion Tree stands and where Elspeth once fought.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane where Elspeth once raised her sword to protect the innocent.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: The device whose explosion Elspeth remembers and wonders if she died in.

entities.name: Elspeth's old home dungeon
entities.description: A mildewed dungeon a stone's throw from Elspeth's old family home, where she relives her mother's death.

events.summary: Elspeth wakes inside a memory in her childhood dungeon and kills a Phyrexian-like beast to save the girl, her younger self, standing over her slain mother.
events.quote: This time, she does what the girl could only dream of doing. This time, she has a sword.

events.summary: The girl speaks with an adult voice and warns that a splicer is coming; Elspeth realizes the girl is her younger self and is told to wake up.
Elspeth is told by the voice, now in her mother's likeness, that she must make one more choice about where to intervene as the planes burn.
events.quote: You must choose where to intervene,

events.summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
Elspeth finds she cannot affect events as an observer, even as Phyrexian beasts slaughter citizens.
events.quote: She tries to save the man only for her hands to fade through him.

events.summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
Elspeth falls to Theros and is welcomed by Daxos's voice; she sees Meletis in ruins.
events.quote: "So you've not forgotten me, even with the new station,"

events.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: He's already changed three of them.

events.summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
events.quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

events.summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
events.quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

events.summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
events.quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

events.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
events.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

events.summary: Norn tells the Mirrans that they will be freed of their skin's treachery; Elspeth reaches for her sword.
The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
events.quote: Killing her will not end this.

events.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
events.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

events.summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

events.summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
events.quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

events.summary: Elspeth tells Serra she is afraid, and Serra embraces her, tells her fear is last to leave and remakes her.
events.quote: "Fear is always the last thing to leave,"

events.summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
events.quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

relations.note: Her mother appears in the dungeon memory
relations.quote: She knows that the woman on the ground is the girl's mother.

relations.note: Serra says she can forge Elspeth into what she was always meant to be
relations.quote: But I can forge you into what you were always meant to be.

relations.note: Elspeth calls Ajani her old mentor
relations.quote: Why not repay her old mentor for everything he'd done for her?

relations.note: Daxos is an old friend she cannot forget
relations.quote: "I couldn't forget you if I tried."

relations.note: Atraxa is one of their fanatical generals
relations.quote: One of their most fanatical generals.

relations.note: Jin-Gitaxias bows to the Grand Praetor
relations.quote: "As the Grand Praetor speaks, so Phyrexia wills."
"Mother of Machines, we await your righteous judgment upon them."

relations.note: Ajani works to convert the gods of Theros to Phyrexian oil
relations.quote: could she stand back and watch as Ajani anointed him in this foul oil?

relations.note: They once said the same thing about cutting off a rotten limb
relations.quote: Just as Elspeth knew what had to be done, so did Wrenn.
